tasks.name: Model data with dataclasses and enums

concepts.name: functools.wraps in decorators
concepts.description: `functools.wraps()` preserves selected metadata on wrapper functions and exposes the original callable through `__wrapped__`, improving introspection and tooling.

concepts.name: functools.cache and lru_cache
concepts.description: `functools.cache` provides unbounded memoization while `lru_cache(maxsize=...)` bounds entries; cached call arguments must be hashable.

concepts.name: functools.partial
concepts.description: `functools.partial()` creates a callable with selected arguments pre-filled and delays execution until the new callable is invoked.

concepts.name: dataclass default_factory
concepts.description: `field(default_factory=...)` calls a factory for each instance that needs a default, which is the standard pattern for fresh mutable values.

concepts.name: dataclasses.replace
concepts.description: `dataclasses.replace()` creates another object of the same dataclass type with selected fields changed and runs the normal initialization path for the new object.

concepts.name: Enum auto values
concepts.description: `enum.auto()` delegates member-value generation to the Enum machinery; default generated values depend on the enum type.

concepts.name: contextlib.contextmanager
concepts.description: `@contextmanager` adapts a one-yield generator function into a context manager, with setup before `yield` and exit/cleanup work after it.

concepts.name: contextlib.suppress
concepts.description: `contextlib.suppress()` intentionally ignores only specified exception types inside a narrow `with` scope; other exceptions propagate.

concepts.name: contextlib.nullcontext
concepts.description: `contextlib.nullcontext(enter_result)` returns the supplied object on entry and otherwise performs no setup or cleanup, preserving caller ownership.
